create.name: Karuna Buddhist Vihara
create.bio:
Karuna Buddhist Vihara, also known as Compassion Monastery, is a small Theravada monastery for bhikkhunis, fully ordained Buddhist nuns, in Sunnyvale, California. It began in 2012 as a neighbourhood monastery and is registered in California as a nonprofit Buddhist church. Its two resident nuns, Ayya Santussikā and Ayya Cittānandā, live at a forest hermitage in the Santa Cruz Mountains, bought in 2019, and hold public programmes at the vihara's meditation centre in Sunnyvale; Bhikkhu Bodhi and Bhante Walpola Piyananda serve as advisors.

Teaching is offered freely and supported by dana. Each week brings chanting, meditation and Dhamma talks, with a Friday evening sutta study that works through the long, middle-length, connected and numerical discourses of the Pali Canon, in person and on Zoom. The nuns also lead day-long and residential retreats at centres around the United States, and the website shares recorded talks and a self-guided version of its upasika training for committed lay practitioners. Talks by the nuns and guest teachers are posted on its YouTube channel most weeks.

courses.title: Retreats with the KBV bhikkhunis
courses.description: Residential retreats led by the vihara's nuns at retreat centres around the United States, with the 2027 dates and venues listed on this page, among them the Insight Meditation Society in Barre and Cloud Mountain Retreat Center.

free_resources.title: Sutta Study (Friday evenings, Sunnyvale and Zoom)
free_resources.description: A weekly evening of chanting and meditation followed by reading and discussion of the Buddha's discourses from the Pali Canon. Open to people of any faith, in the meditation centre or online.

free_resources.title: Self-Guided Upasika Training Program
free_resources.description: Downloadable monthly readings and exercises from the vihara's training for dedicated lay followers, arranged so that a teacher or a peer group can work through them together.

free_resources.title: Dhamma Talks
free_resources.description: Recorded Dhamma talks by the vihara's nuns to stream or download.
